newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil prison standoff ends peacefully.
newsitem.headline: Brazil prison standoff ends peacefully.

text.p: A tense prison standoff ended peacefully in Brazil on Friday, when rioting inmates freed five hostages they seized during an uprising to protest living conditions, authorities said.
"Everybody was released and everything is now under control," said a spokesman at Pinheiros Prison in Sao Paulo.
Inmates took over the prison on Thursday afternoon, burning mattresses, hurling roof tiles at police and taking guards and nurses hostage.

The spokesman said he could not say what the demands of the prisoners were or whether authorities had agreed to satisfy any of them. News reports said a group of inmates wanted 210 prisoners convicted of crimes to be separated from 300 others awaiting trial.
